idea-plugin.name: WordPress Privacy Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Finds the 12 author-side privacy duties your plugin PHP breaks, with the article and the fix on every line.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → WordPress Privacy Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 12 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/wordpress-privacy-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/wordpress-privacy-lint

action.text: WordPress Privacy Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run WordPress Privacy Lint on the file in the editor
